root_cause.mechanism: The live seed's distribution was wrong: 14 of 17 posts were crammed into r/p2pbuilders and 9 of 11 boards were empty, and the owner-ordered community swap (fediverse + cypherpunk -> redditalternatives + showcase) had never been applied. The reseed (RESEED-MANIFEST-2026-08-06.json, sha256 f3d660a10419e2fd588e3349b9a9fcd4b72c1f0f034274beaee389193df00f64) rebalances to 7 content boards and applies the swap. The okey (HMAC over owner‖_t‖semanticId where semanticId includes the board) and the cell intentId both include the board, so a moved post mints a NEW cell recordId/slot while its contentId (seed-derived) is unchanged; the old cell is thereby superseded by slot. Unchanged records keep identical CIDs and are LWW-overwritten in place (idempotent, no duplicates).
correction_applied: Community swap applied: fediverse + cypherpunk community claims dropped; redditalternatives + showcase community claims minted.
7 posts re-minted from r/p2pbuilders to correct boards (selfhosted, hiverelay, localfirst x3, homelab, showcase); their nested reply cells re-minted too.

Distribution now: 7 content boards (p2pbuilders 7 posts, ai_local 3, localfirst 3, selfhosted 1, hiverelay 1, homelab 1, showcase 1) and 4 reserved bounty boards left empty (nostr, privacy, redditalternatives, osint).

Published all waves to BOTH relays immediately via the drill-proven blind CELL path: 34/34 records (39 cells), every write with a signed relay receipt and byte-exact readback PASS, idempotent LWW-overwrite (leaseClass-4, ~90-day leases).

superseded_cells_documented.no_protocol_purge: a protocol CELL.DROP requires the per-cell dropPrivateKey, an ephemeral random ed25519 seed generated at CELL.PUT and bound into the allocation commitment; the publisher used an in-memory capability vault (memoryCapabilityVaultKv), so those keys were never persisted and are unrecoverable (the readcap vault stores only reader capabilities). No relay operator purge route exists for blind cells. Owner direction: accept lease-expiry GC.
